decisions.proposedLead: Private health insurance does not remove the 2% Medicare levy [[MEDICARE_LEVY.rate]], which every resident taxpayer above the low-income threshold pays; it only exempts the holder from the Medicare levy surcharge. The surcharge for 2026-27 [[MLS_INCOME_YEAR]] is 1%, 1.25% or 1.5% of income for singles earning over $105,000 or families over $210,000 [[MEDICARE_LEVY.surcharge]] who have no eligible hospital cover.

evidence.note: was: Schedule 5 — published by the ATO as NAT 3348 — is the tax table employers use to withhold PAYG from bonuses, commissions and back payments. Instead of taxing the lump sum like a normal pay, it spread

decisions.proposedLead: The Schedule 5 tax table is the ATO schedule (NAT 3348) employers use to withhold PAYG from bonuses, commissions and back pay in 2026-27. There is no flat bonus tax rate: the payment is spread across 26 fortnights or 52 weeks so withholding tracks the employee's marginal rate, with a 47% ceiling [[SCHEDULE_5_WITHHOLDING_LIMIT]]. On $2,000 a fortnight, a $1,000 bonus attracts $312 [[calculateSchedule5MethodB]].

evidence.note: was: Calculate the tax impact of working two jobs. See why your second job appears to be taxed more, how PAYG withholding works without the tax-free threshold, and your estimated refund at tax time.

decisions.proposedLead: There is no separate tax rate for a second job in Australia: income from both jobs is added together and taxed once at the 2026-27 marginal rates. What differs is withholding, because the second employer uses the ATO's no-tax-free-threshold scale [[SCALE_1_NO_TFT]], which takes $180 (18.0%) from a $1,000 fortnight [[withholdingForPeriod]] instead of applying the $18,200 threshold twice. Over-withholding is refunded.

decisions.proposedLead: An estimated tax return is the difference between the PAYG tax withheld from 1 July 2025 to 30 June 2026 and the tax owed on the 2025-26 scale: $18,200 tax-free, then 16% to $45,000 and 30% to $135,000 [[TAX_BRACKETS_2025_26]], plus the 2% Medicare levy. More withheld than owed is a refund; less is a bill. The return is due 31 October 2026 if self-lodged, or 15 May 2027 through most tax agents [[RETURN_2026]].
